# Getting help

| You want to… | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Learn how something works | The [user guide](../docs/guide/index.md), and its [FAQ](../docs/guide/faq.md) |
| Fix a failed check or a setup problem | `sekhemet doctor`, then [Troubleshooting](../docs/guide/troubleshooting.md) |
| Ask a question | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/brennansk1/sekhemet/discussions), *Q&A* |
| Suggest an idea | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/brennansk1/sekhemet/discussions), *Ideas* |
| Report a bug | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/brennansk1/sekhemet/issues/new/choose), with the bug form |
| Report a vulnerability | Privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says; never in an issue |

Discussions and Issues open with the public pre-release 0.9.0.

**When you report a bug,** run `sekhemet doctor --report`. It writes a folder, prints its path and lists what is in it — the checks, the settings, counts from the Activity log and the end of the diagnostic logs — with secrets, your paths, login, host name and email addresses taken out. Nothing is sent anywhere. Read it, then attach it.

Sekhemet is maintained by one person, in the open. Answers may take a few days; there is no paid support.
